def sig(frame):
    return [(n['color'], n['pixels'], tuple(tuple(p) for p in n['boundary'])) for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']]

    return sorted((min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')

print("click-empty diff:", [x for x in list(b2-a2)+list(a2-b2) if x[0] not in ('W','w') or x[2][0][0] > 5])
print("greens:", greens(current_frame))

</function>
